Medium overall facial tension maintaining natural masculine structure. Expression conveys quiet confidence, controlled power, aspirational luxury without warmth or accessibility—editorial intensity with restraint.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Describe hand from multiple angles: 'palm slightly angled toward camera, fingers extending upward, natural finger spacing'. Reference real hand anatomy patterns. Keep hand gesture simple and clear.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to body proportion risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Verify natural shoulder-to-head proportion. Ensure both arms scale correctly to torso width. Maintain anatomically accurate elbow and wrist positioning.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to finger count risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Explicitly state 'two fingers extended: index finger and middle finger clearly separated'. Reference 'V-sign peace gesture' as established pattern. Consider fallback to simpler hand positions if generation fails.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to stiff pose risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Ensure shoulders remain naturally relaxed, consider subtle weight shift or asymmetry if generating similar poses

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand face overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Maintain clear spatial separation between elevated product-holding hand and face. Ensure product and hand remain in distinct depth plane from facial features.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to selfie generic risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Layer specific emotional and physical details beyond 'selfie' label. Emphasize unique facial expression details, specific smile type, exact gaze quality. Avoid relying solely on 'selfie' as prompt.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to mouth anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Focus on natural smile shape and cheek elevation rather than forcing exact dental detail, allow slight motion blur on teeth if needed to avoid uncanny precision, prioritize smile authenticity over perfect dental rendering

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to glasses reflection risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Reference natural sunglass lens darkness and subtle environmental reflections. Avoid overly detailed or impossible reflections. Maintain opaque dark lenses consistent with outdoor lighting.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to low angle distortion risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Use camera angle terminology carefully. Specify 'slight low angle' rather than extreme. Emphasize natural facial proportions. Reference 'handheld selfie perspective' for context without forcing extreme distortion.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand phone overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Simplify phone-hand interaction, use 'phone held naturally in relaxed grip' rather than detailed finger positions

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to fake candid pose risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Preserve authentic UGC qualities: natural window light variations, lived-in bathroom environment, slight imperfections in pose symmetry. Avoid overly polished studio perfection.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to uncanny smile risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Emphasize Duchenne smile markers: genuine eye crinkling, natural cheek push creating crow's feet, eyebrow slight lift, ensure all smile muscles engage together not just mouth

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to dead eyes risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Specify 'intense focused gaze with presence, alive eyes with controlled confidence' to avoid flatness

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to garment boundary risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: If recreating bare chest look, specify 'bare chest, pendant necklace visible, no shirt'. If adding clothing, carefully specify neckline type and ensure natural fabric drape.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand clothing overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Ensure clear finger separation and hand-to-fabric boundary definition. Maintain slight tonal contrast between hand skin and garment fabric even in dark clothing. Verify all visible fingers maintain clear anatomical structure and don't blend into sleeve material. Consider slightly lighter hand rendering or subtle rim lighting to separate from dark fabric.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to neck anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Render neck with natural muscle definition, proper throat structure, accurate skin tension for lifted chin position; avoid over-elongation while maintaining natural neck length

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to extreme crop risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Maintain clear space around head; ensure neck and shoulders provide visual foundation

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to sunglasses reflection risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Specify 'dark tinted sunglasses with subtle environmental reflection' to avoid both flat appearance and overly detailed/incorrect reflections. Keep lens darkness consistent.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand hair overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Pay careful attention to hair-finger boundary zones, ensure hair maintains separate strand definition where hand touches, avoid blurred transition zones between hand and hair

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to profile anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Reference clear profile anatomical structure. Ensure ear is properly positioned relative to eye line and jaw angle is naturally defined.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to seated pose complexity.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Break pose into component parts: seated base position, forward torso lean, open leg stance, hand placement. Ensure weight distribution reads naturally for seated position.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand prop overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Clearly define where fingers contact glass stem, maintain separation between hand and glass body, ensure grip reads as natural hold not fusion

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to top down distortion risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Carefully specify top-down perspective with natural proportions, reference architectural photography principles, emphasize correct facial proportion from above, calibrate body length carefully

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to arm anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Specify relaxed arm positioning, natural shoulder socket anatomy, realistic muscle definition for raised arm position, gradual foreshortening

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to extreme angle complexity.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Provide clear perspective instructions, reference similar editorial top-down shots, specify camera positioned directly above subject, emphasize natural proportions despite angle

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to profile lighting complexity risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Balance strong key light from window with subtle fill to prevent excessive shadow density. Maintain soft shadow transitions on face to preserve facial structure detail. Ensure nose shadow doesn't create harsh line across cheek. Keep neck and jaw shadows natural and dimensional.

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand counter overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Focus on clear counter surface plane; establish hands as firmly placed on counter with natural wrist angles; maintain clear spatial separation between hands and product containers; avoid ambiguous hand-object merging

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hair physics risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Allow hair to fall naturally backward with head position, maintain curl pattern integrity, avoid frozen or anti-gravity hair positioning

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to hand table overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Describe contact clearly: 'hands resting on table with fingers naturally draped over the edge, clear depth separation between hand and table surface, realistic contact points where palm meets table top.'

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to torso twist risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Reference natural seated torso rotation; keep twist subtle; ensure shoulder asymmetry follows natural body mechanics

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to shoulder anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Specify natural shoulder blade movement; reference asymmetric shoulder poses; maintain realistic muscle structure

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to ankle foot anatomy risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Use 'natural foot position' and 'realistic ankle bend'; de-emphasize foot detail if errors occur

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to mirror reflection logic risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Reference mirror selfie mechanics explicitly, validate left-right flip consistency, ensure phone camera faces mirror

riskRules.definition: Potential visual error related to furniture body overlap risk.
riskRules.fixStrategy: Emphasize natural body weight distribution in soft furniture, realistic cushion compression around body, clear separation between body and sofa where visible

rules: Do not mix mirror gaze with direct lens gaze unless intentionally hybrid.
Do not pair no-hand gesture with phone selfie camera.
Do not use pout expression without mouth anatomy risk controls.
